title: Contact Us
intro: We're a small team and we read every message. Whether you have a question about MagicMail, a bug to report, or just want to say hello — we'd love to hear from you.

sections.heading: 1. General support
paragraphs: For questions about your account, billing, or how MagicMail works, email us at hello@magicmail.app. We typically reply within one business day.

sections.heading: 2. Bug reports and feature requests
paragraphs: If you've found a bug or have an idea for something we should build, we'd love to hear it. Please include:
list: A short description of what happened
The steps you took before it happened
A screenshot or screen recording, if you have one

sections.heading: 3. Security
paragraphs: If you believe you've found a security vulnerability in MagicMail, please email security@magicmail.app directly. We take every report seriously and will respond within 48 hours.
Please don't publicly disclose the issue until we've had a chance to investigate and ship a fix.

sections.heading: 4. Privacy and data requests
paragraphs: For questions about your data, requests to export it, or requests to delete your account, email privacy@magicmail.app. We honor all valid data requests within 30 days.

sections.heading: 5. Business and partnerships
paragraphs: If you're interested in partnering with us, integrating MagicMail into your product, or exploring something else — reach out to hello@magicmail.app and we'll route your message to the right person.
